blocking.required_change: Make a Declaration or IndependenceAct returned by declarationAt or independenceAt mean that the ledger's own HUMAN-only append produced it. An entry another module appended directly to the shared record, labelled author 'HUMAN' and kind 'declaration' or 'independence', must not come back as a catalog act, and neither may a declaration at a level outside levels(). A test that appends such an entry through the record port must turn red against the current code. If this layer cannot decide the property (it may need record-port provenance, PC-02), the owner must rule on it and register it as a limit, and the battery-7 R10/R11 record must be corrected by supersession, because it says the runtime INV-PROV breach is closed.

REF-01's property is that no definition outside the ledger produces a Declaration. A derivation that returns one through a value typed `any`, and one that returns it through a generic identity-cast helper, must each turn test_declaration_from_derivation_is_malformed red, each with a positive-control fixture. Whatever part of this the checker cannot decide must be registered as a limit, and IR-30's claim that an explicit assertion is the only escape must be corrected.

BC-03-4's 'no exported operation answers the current declaration' must be decided over every exported callable that can reveal a declaration's content, not only class methods whose return carries the brand. A method returning the current level as a plain string, a read that takes a 'HUMAN'-typed parameter but no RecordHeight, and an exported free function doing either must each turn test_no_operation_answers_the_current_declaration red, with positive-control fixtures.

Register the provenance-by-author-string read mechanism (declaration-ledger.ts:91-99, independence-ledger.ts:67-76) as an interpretation, with its class and route. Also correct IR-30 and the catalog-checks.mjs header so neither claims that an `as` assertion is the only way to mint a branded catalog act.
